comment: Manual pricing overrides for Venice West Tixr events that cannot be scraped automatically due to anti-bot protection
instructions: To add pricing for a Tixr event, use the event ID from the URL. For example, if the URL is 'https://www.tixr.com/groups/thevenicewest/events/some-event-12345' or 'https://tixr.com/e/12345', use '12345' or 'some-event-12345' as the key.
